## Bring on Holiday Joy with Junior Mints Peppermint Crunch!


Featuring a refreshing peppermint center, creamy chocolate shell, and crunchy bits, these treats offer the perfect holiday indulgence.


### **They’ll Make Your Days Merry and Bright!**


Need to dazzle with some stocking stuffers? These Junior Mints Peppermint Crunch are particularly popular during the holiday season, adding a festive touch to the familiar, beloved candy. They’re the perfect snack for those who love the cool, crisp taste of peppermint with a fun crunch. If you’re a fan of minty treats, you’ll love these! The peppermint inside each mint offer a satisfying texture contrast, making every bite even more enjoyable. But hurry, they’re only available for a limited time!
